An untested backup on the same accessibl: An untested backup on the same accessible network
放在同一个可访问网络上、未经测试的备份

A longer privacy notice alone: 仅把隐私声明写得更长
Removing patient names from email signat: Removing patient names from email signatures
从电子邮件签名中删除患者姓名
